Versus 1...Rd8+ immediately, I don't see a direct forced win; White may consolidate. I still prefer 1...Rd5.

history.name: Assistant
history.content: That reinforces 1...Rd5 as a strong intermediate. On 1...Rd5 2.dxc6 bxc6, Black opens b-file and keeps pressure on White's back rank; the queen on f4 lacks safe squares if Rd1 follows. Tactical details favor Black.

history.name: Assistant

This overreach led the team to adopt the wrong move (Rd8) instead of the correct Rd5. The agent also earlier attempted to access a local file (step 12), a task reserved for FileSurfer, further breaching role boundaries. This Disobey Role Specification (FM-1.2) caused the incorrect final answer.
